description: As a warehouse manager, I want to edit inventory item details through a quick edit modal so that I can make updates without navigating to a separate page.

acs.text: The quick edit modal opens when the user clicks the Edit icon in the item row.
The modal contains fields for Item Name, Quantity, Unit Price, and Category.
On Save, the item row in the table is updated immediately without a page reload.
On Cancel, no changes are saved and the modal closes.
